name: Oppermann's Conjecture
informal: For every integer $x \ge 2$ there exists a prime between $x(x-1)$ and $x^2$.

references.label: Luan Alberto Ferreira, *Real exponential sums over primes and prime gaps*

informal_en: For every integer $x \ge 2$ there exists a prime between $x(x-1)$ and $x^2$.
